claim_text: Improved safety performance (reduced TRIFR by 68% on FY2024).
metric_name: Tomingley TRIFR; recordable injuries; LTI; MTI
context_text:
In FY2025, there were 16 recordable injuries at the Tomingley site, including four Lost Time Injuries (LTI) and five Medical Treated Injuries (MTI). 
The total recordable injury frequency rate (TRIFR) was 9.9, a 68 percent reduction on FY2024 (TRIFR of 31.2). There were also 54 first aid injuries treated.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: The reported TRIFR fell from 31.2 to 9.9, directly supporting the claim of improved safety performance.
notes: the FY2025 TRIFR value is reported inconsistently as 9.9 in the text and 9.0 in the table.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that safety performance improved, specifically that TRIFR was reduced by 68% compared with FY2024. The evidence states that the Tomingley site TRIFR in FY2025 was 9.9 and that this represents a 68% reduction on FY2024, when TRIFR was 31.2. This directly substantiates the claimed 68% reduction versus FY2024 and supports the stated improvement in safety performance.
